name: Fresh crossed closed-loop confirmation (internally fixed protocol with code hashes; not externally preregistered)

scenarios.design: each factor exactly balanced and independently shuffled (motion x obstacle-count crossed, all 16 cells populated)

settings: frozen from earlier archived tuning; nothing tuned on this set (see PARAMS in fresh_confirmation_run.py)
primary_method: DR-T with the age-based deposit and 500-step limit (arm legacy)

arms.other: space-time A*, SIPP-style, D* Lite+DWA, ACO+DWA, ORCA, MPC

primary_family: DR-T(legacy) vs each of HB(legacy), HBP(legacy), ACO+DWA, space-time A*, SIPP-style, D* Lite+DWA, ORCA, MPC on both outcomes: exact McNemar on paired scenarios, 16 tests, Holm correction
secondary: flat-deposit arm; DR-SAFE vs DR-T; subgroup tables by motion, obstacle count, noise, workspace (descriptive); logistic-free, no inference on subgroups
caveats: ORCA/MPC settings are the archived 4-scenario tuning bests (the paper's widened-grid ORCA/MPC settings are not archived)
ORCA and MPC replan every tick in the archived runner
